providerBehavior.statement: Paseo deterministically disables OpenCode `auto_accept` whenever the agent config carries a `toolPolicy`: `@getpaseo/server@0.9.1` dist/server/server/agent/providers/opencode-agent.js:2425 sets `this.autoAcceptEnabled = !config.toolPolicy && isOpenCodeAutoAcceptEnabled(config)`. Every AEH participant launch with the context/result MCP preapprovals carries a toolPolicy, so `featureValues.auto_accept: true` alone can never clear a provider approval prompt.
providerBehavior.evidence: daemon-stored agent config `featureValues.auto_accept: true` + `toolPolicy.preapproved` (agent 3c313277-0aff-4c96-b1de-2a6ca5535017); provider source line as cited

providerBehavior.statement: Paseo child agents inherit the parent agent's workspace and execute in the parent's cwd, ignoring the requested create cwd.
providerBehavior.evidence: probe6: parent created at /home/james/.paseo/worktrees/1yo7ez85/aeh-change-20260928t224304z-e75534ab (workspace wks_e48e73753b74a9eb); child created with cwd=/tmp/aeh-r13-probe-wt and parent=parentId observed cwd=/home/james/.paseo/worktrees/1yo7ez85/... and workspaceId=wks_e48e73753b74a9eb (requested cwd ignored)

aehDefects.statement: The OpenCode permission projection never declared `external_directory` for the frozen participant launch root. Because Paseo sibling tooling can relocate or reference the task worktree's git metadata outside the provider project root, OpenCode gated access behind `external_directory` and the session stopped at the approval prompt.
aehDefects.repair: src/agents/permissions.ts projects a scoped `external_directory` allow for the resolved launch root and its git metadata roots when the compiled role has read/write/shell authority; Semantic Assessor and fully denied roles receive nothing; filesystem root and relative candidates are ignored. src/paseo/launchSpec.ts passes the launch root plus `worktreeGitRoots(root)` (new `src/core/git.ts` helper).
aehDefects.probeEvidence: probe2 outside-denied reproduced status=permission with pending name=external_directory patterns=[<outside>/*]; outside-allowed and scoped-pattern variants completed with zero prompts

aehDefects.statement: The Paseo SDK discarded the pending approval payload returned by `WaitForFinishResult.final.pendingPermissions`, so the stopped permission identity was never durable (R12-F2 evidence gap).
aehDefects.repair: src/paseo/sdk.ts captures a bounded permission stop detail (name/title/description/patterns) from `waitForFinish` final snapshots and handle snapshots; src/paseo/native.ts does the same on the subscription wait path; src/paseo/runtimeCore.ts includes it in the failed-turn stderr.
regressions: tests/paseoRuntime.test.ts (retains the provider approval identity and scope)

aehDefects.statement: Codex participant sessions ran with the provider-default `on-request` approval policy, so a real Repairer turn stopped on `CodexBash`/`CodexFileChange`.
aehDefects.repair: src/paseo/launchSpec.ts projects provider-native `providerOptions` from the compiled permission ceiling: `approval_policy: never`, `sandbox_mode: workspace-write` with `writable_roots` (frozen launch + git metadata roots) and `network_access` from the ceiling, or `read-only` when the role cannot write/shell. `src/paseo/sdk.ts` sends `config.options`; `src/paseo/runtimeCore.ts` refuses CLI fallback when provider options exist (fail closed, never silently drop the sandbox projection).

aehDefects.statement: AEH passed the supervisor as the Paseo `parent` for isolated wave-task launches; Paseo children inherit the parent workspace/cwd, so the isolated Implementer session executed inside the operation candidate workspace and mutated it, tripping the deterministic receipt gate with CANDIDATE_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH.
aehDefects.repair: src/paseo/launchSpec.ts suppresses the Paseo parent handle for launches whose frozen root differs from the durable operation workspace root (`paseoParentAgentId`), keeping `aeh.parent-agent`/`AEH_PARENT_AGENT_ID` correlation. The provider can no longer relocate the isolated session.
regressions: tests/paseoLaunchSpec.test.ts (isolated launch keeps the label but drops the Paseo parent handle)
